releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.19 — the published app now uses the real backend by default (no setup needed), and the demo data is gone: no mock chats, friends or statuses anywhere. Photos, videos and documents now actually upload and send, statuses can be created, privacy settings are stored on the server, avatars upload, and calls ring the other person and land in History. Settings ▸ Server still points any install at your own server.
